findings.message: The following .npmrc file(s) set a package registry, which is not allowed. Remove the registry setting - the build must resolve every dependency from the default public npm registry (registry.npmjs.org). A custom registry pulls the declared package names from an undeclared source, making package.json and the lock file a decoy.

The following committed build artifact(s) are not allowed. A built archive (a .xpi/.zip) is produced from the source during the build and must never be part of the submission, where its bytes cannot be verified against what the build produces. Remove them and resubmit.
